title: Tech Debt Row
description: Shape of a single row in docs/TECH_DEBT.md. Enforced by scripts/validate-tech-debt-schema.sh; illustrated by assets/templates/tech-debt-row-template.yaml. Unlike risk-register-row.schema.json, this schema has no append-only companion script -- rows are deleted, not archived, once resolved (see SKILL.md Rules).

id.description: A simple row number, not a permanence claim -- freely reused once a row is deleted, since there is no audit requirement to anchor against (unlike risk-register's append-only-backed id).

area.description: A small, tech-debt-specific taxonomy tracked in SKILL.md, not a closed enum here -- starts minimal and grows only when an item genuinely doesn't fit an existing value. See SKILL.md's Area Taxonomy section for the current set.

description.description: Self-contained: what's wrong, where, and why existing gates didn't catch it. A reader with no other context should understand it.

effort.description: Sizing only, matching this project's existing effort convention (.context/plans/ frontmatter, skill-auditor remediation plans). A suggested fix approach belongs in description, not here.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the date the row was created.

status.description: No "Resolved" value -- a resolved row is deleted (see SKILL.md Rules), so that state is never observed by construction. "In Progress" distinguishes filed-but-not-started from actively-being-worked.
